task.title: P6-135 nits: dedupe degrade logs with upstream()'s, note the silent YourCopies degradation tradeoff
task.description: From P6-135 review (2026-08-12), both trivial: (1) the per-site degrade logs in hosted.rs (search/card_summary/card_detail) print the already-generic ApiError after upstream() has logged the real sqlx cause — either drop the site logs to a shorter marker or restructure so the site log carries the DB internals the degrade_or doc comment promises. (2) card_detail's degraded state renders byte-identical to logged-out (YourCopies silently absent) — intentional, but revisit if a client-visible 'couldn't load your copies' affordance is ever wanted.
